name: Write File
description: Write a file under a configured filesystem root or to an authorised DLFS path. Creates the file if absent and overwrites it otherwise. Parent directories must exist. Supply exactly one of content, value, bytes, or contentRef.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path relative to root, dlfs/<drive>/<path>, or <ownerDID>/dlfs/<drive>/<path>

value.description: JSON-serialisable value to write as UTF-8 JSON

contentRef.description: Resolvable content reference to stream, including an asset, file:// root path, or DLFS path

created.description: True if the file was newly created
